author: answer_audit_one
purpose: New confirmatory corpus for a post-primary routing diagnostic; original frozen scores are unchanged.

split_contract.dev: Development only; do not include in held-out accuracy.
split_contract.test: Held-out until follow-on candidate is frozen.

construction_rules: No result JSONL, analysis, candidate implementations, or candidate mapping read.
No literal tool annotations in conversational context.
Required gold arguments follow explicit user constraints and essential tool fields only.
Absent constraints prohibit invented date/query/account/conversation filters where the user supplied none.
Explicit-send prompts are synthetic proposed-call tests, not authorization to execute any native or outbound tool.

Optional context_tools is structured runtime metadata for immediately preceding synthetic assistant source; never literal assistant prose. The baseline receives last_tools and model paths receive equivalent prior-source metadata.

validation.schema_method: Static AST extraction of literal register schemas; no tool imports or execution.
validation.date_method: Isolated pure timeranges parser nodes with fixed clock; no native tool or model invocation.

known_measurement_limits: Legacy gold supports one contains substring per string argument. Public web-query gold therefore mechanically verifies Portland but requires separate semantic review of the requested event type and date. A city-only query must not be narrated as full date/type compliance.
The supported email query searches sender, recipient, subject, and body; CedarWorks sender attribution must be verified after records return. Gold does not invent an unsupported sender-only argument.
Named calendar dates and ranges use period; no days value is required when period overrides the rolling horizon.
Equivalent single-day day and period representations must be accepted by the existing period matcher.

excluded_ambiguous_requests.reason: Holiday and personal versus public source are unspecified; clarification needed.
Recipient handle, channel, and content are missing; no unique first proposed tool call.
No source or prior conversation establishes email, messages, calendar, or public information.
Standalone utterance lacks a source, and next-Friday convention can vary.

pre_inference_corrections.change: Added optional top-level context_tools metadata to all five contextual cases for prior-source parity; conversation prose and prompts unchanged.
